defect: combinational clock switching relies on an unspecified service-mode protocol
rationale: service_mode selects between two asynchronous running clocks through a combinational mux. A fixed selection established while clocks are stopped can be safe; switching during operation can generate runt or extra edges. The supplied design and constraints do not specify whether or when service_mode changes.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: A plain combinational mux switches between two declared-asynchronous clocks under an unsynchronised select, so a service_mode change can produce a clock glitch/runt pulse on the command_q flops; no glitch-free clock switch is used.

labels.by: gpt-6.1-sol (separate settling reader, the cases and both arguments only)
labels.note: Lines 11-12 clock registers through a combinational mux of clocks the SDC declares asynchronous. A change of service_mode can make a spurious edge, but nothing establishes whether selection is static or follows a safe switching protocol.
